name: [TONGKAT ES!] Mount Dukun
desc:
Climb the Crystal-Peri Mountain through 14 checkpoints to the beautiful summit. Explore blue forests, sparkling waterfalls, and giant shaman statues - many epic photo spots! Adjust the mood as you wish by changing the sky, carry friends to help with the climb, and emote/dance together to create exciting moments.

Main Features:
- 14 structured checkpoints
- Sky Switcher: change the sky at any time
- Carry System: lift/drop friends to the checkpoint
- Emotes & Dances for photos/video content 
- Beautiful summit + hangout area & many photo spots 
- Leaderboard: Top Summit / Top Time / Top Magic 

Let's join!
Like, favorite, and invite your friends to climb Mount Dukun.

Note: This map is still in the BETA stage, please understand if there are bugs.
